title: ModMaker build manifest
description: The compile contract: a fully resolved description of one mod to build. Successor to the legacy <ModMaker> XML, in JSON. FULLY RESOLVED means the compiler needs neither the definition bundle nor the project file to act on it - inheritance, defaults, dimensions and struct serialization have all already been applied, and every value is final config text. `jobs` is a discriminated list so new kinds of work (package edits, file copies) can be added without disturbing what already exists.

format.description: Manifest schema version. A compiler seeing a higher value must refuse cleanly rather than partially build.

kind.description: Magic string, so a stray .json is not mistaken for a build manifest.

game.description: Game identity. LMP is Project Milan's own; LE3 is what a stock Legendary Edition install reports.

generator.description: Provenance. Diagnostic only - the compiler must never need it to build.

mod.description: Everything needed to write the moddesc and the DLC folder.

dlcFolder.description: DLC folder name to generate. Always "DLC_MOD_ModMaker": a ModMaker mod is a single DLC, and building a second one replaces the first. The pattern stays permissive so the format can outlive that decision, but the compiler does not choose.

mount.description: mount.dlc contents. Must mount above Project Milan so this DLC's config overrides it.

tlkId.description: String ref carrying the DLC's display name. Any positive integer; ModMaker uses a fixed one, since there is only ever one ModMaker DLC.

flags.description: Game 3 mount flags (EME3MountFileFlag), as the integer written into mount.dlc: 0x01 SaveFileDependency, 0x02 DLCSetupCanMisMatch, 0x04 LoadsInMultiplayer, 0x08 LoadsInSingleplayer, 0x10 UsedInMatchMaking, 0x20 UsesGoBigFeatures. Resolved at compile time by copying the DLC this mod mounts above, because a config override must load wherever the content it overrides loads.

jobs.description: Ordered work items. Today only `coalesced`; `package` is reserved for the return of binary edits.

coalescedJob.description: Write a coalesced into the generated DLC. Values are final config text; the compiler does not parse or interpret them.

files.description: Keyed by coalesced sub-file without extension: BioGame, BioWeapon, BioAI, BioDifficulty, BioUI, ...

name.description: Coalesced section name, e.g. "sfxgamecontent.sfxpowercustomaction_pull". Real ME3/LE3 section names can contain spaces, and array-property paths use "section&property".

value.description: Final config text for a plain write, already serialized, e.g. "(BaseValue=750.0,Formula=BonusIsHardValue)" or "1.5f". Mutually exclusive with `replace`.

valueType.description: Coalesced value type (LegendaryExplorerCore CoalesceParseAction): 0 New/overwrite, 1 RemoveProperty, 2 Add, 3 AddUnique, 4 Remove. Matters because this coalesced merges over Milan's.

source.description: Originating leaf id. Diagnostic only - lets a bad value in a built mod be traced back to a control in the editor.

replace.description: Array-property override. The compiler writes a type-4 (Remove) of `remove` followed by a type-3 (AddUnique) of `add`. Paired deliberately rather than left as two loose entries, because the order is load-bearing and the removal is EXACT-TEXT-SENSITIVE - if `remove` differs from the shipped value in any way the subtraction silently fails and the game ends up with both entries.

remove.description: Verbatim original config text, byte-for-byte as shipped.

packageJob.description: RESERVED. Placeholder for the eventual return of package-level edits - the capability MixIns used to provide (feasibility 4.4). Nothing produces or consumes this yet; it exists so the format has a defined shape to grow into rather than being redesigned later.
